# UUIDGen

> Generate RFC 9562 UUIDv4, time-ordered UUIDv7, and ULID monotonic unique identifiers.

## Overview
UUIDGen is an official zero-cookie, client-side utility in the OTHRYS Sovereign Fleet.
It executes entirely inside the user's browser via native Web APIs, WebCrypto, and WebAssembly.

- **Canonical URL:** https://uuidgen.othrys.be/
- **Category:** Identifiers & Database
- **Architecture:** 100% Client-Side In-Memory Execution
- **Zero-Telemetry Guarantee:** Zero cookies, zero third-party trackers, zero server logging.
- **Offline Mode:** Fully functional offline Progressive Web App (PWA).

## Headless Terminal Access (CLI)
This utility supports direct headless terminal queries via curl or wget:
```bash
curl -s https://uuidgen.othrys.be/
```
Outputs raw clean text to standard output without HTML wrapper.

## Core Capabilities
- Instant execution with sub-millisecond local latency.
- Confidential enterprise compliance: proprietary data, code, or tokens never cross the network.
- Sovereign Fleet Spotlight: Type `Cmd+K` or `/` in-app to quickly jump to any sister utility.
